AI bookie

Ask Claude, briefed as a Clash Royale expert, to invent new specials. The book prices them from the same simulations as everything else, and only the ones you publish go on the board. Each ask uses a little of your own Claude usage.

Settings

Tower HP defaults to level 11 (3,052 Princess and 4,824 King). Check a fresh tower in your next draft and change these if they don't match. Margin is the house edge: at 5%, every market's chances add up to about 105%. Bet Builders carry their own, higher margin because combos are harder to price.
